trackerDiscrepancy.resolution: Carry forward all 147 unique open source IDs. Do not delete two records to preserve the earlier arithmetic total.

identityRule: Each Phase 7.1C contradiction or quarantine retains its original source ID as the Phase 7.2 key; no source record is silently merged, deleted or promoted into geometry.
countingRule: Direct enumeration of unique chapter-record source IDs controls migration totals. The tracker value is retained only as a documented legacy discrepancy.

defaultGraphState.resolutionPolicy: A quarantine may be superseded only by an explicit later record that cites the original ID and independent evidence.
